product_summary: Hometax is the Korean National Tax Service portal for tax filing, certificates and lookups.

workflows.title: 사업자등록번호로 사업자 상태(휴·폐업) 조회하는 방법
workflows.title_en: Look up a business's status by registration number
workflows.goal: Without logging in, use the Hometax menus (전체메뉴 or the 조회/발급 menu) to open the business status lookup for a registration number (사업자등록상태 조회), enter 1248100998 and run the lookup.
workflows.success_criteria: A lookup result for 124-81-00998 is shown on screen (for example a sentence stating the taxpayer type or that the business is operating, suspended or closed).
workflows.unverified: Menu path inferred from the home page; not explored beforehand.
